summary: PulseGuard v0.6.13 keeps long driver work responsive, restores the automatic post-fix Full Health Rescan, and tightens Game Ready, repair verification, and CPU result accuracy.

sections.heading: Driver FixAll no longer owns the UI thread
sections.detail: The long trusted driver scan/install/verification lane now runs in a separate PowerShell worker while the WinForms message pump stays active, so the main window can continue repainting, moving and updating live status during driver work.

sections.heading: Automatic post-fix Full Health Rescan restored
sections.detail: After FIX + OPTIMIZE ALL completes targeted repair verification, PulseGuard automatically launches the existing complete Full Health Scan in its background worker and refreshes the dashboard/results from the fresh post-fix baseline.

sections.heading: Game Ready decisions are reconciled by app family
sections.detail: SAFE-CLOSE decisions are still made per process, but reporting is aggregated once per app family. Mixed outcomes are shown as PARTIAL with closed/kept process counts instead of contradictory repeated CLOSED and KEPT lines.

sections.heading: Repair proof now recognizes direct startup/registry evidence
sections.detail: Startup entries absent from the post-fix SAFE-DISABLE inventory and registry repairs whose post-review confirms zero remaining SAFE-FIX entries receive direct verified proof instead of being left generically unverified.

sections.heading: Background CPU comparison is fairer and more stable
sections.detail: Optimization before/after CPU now compares actionable plus unresolved background load, not protected Windows/hardware maintenance work. Final sampling adaptively waits for PulseGuard-triggered maintenance activity to settle before showing a regression warning.
